QuestInfo.name: [Smart Mount] Irvin and Social Responsibility
QuestInfo.0: Irvin has such a big smile on his face. It's really creeping you out. He's waving you over, so...
QuestInfo.1: In the name of corporate social responsibility, Irvin has decided to discount Smart Mount items.
QuestInfo.2: News of Irvin permanently cutting the price of Smart Mount items by half has caused quite a stir. Why don't you go pay him a visit?
